observed-problem: A mechanically valid implementation can miss intent; an intended solution can still contain implementation defects.
proposed-rule: Assess intent/contracts and implementation quality separately using independently supported findings.

composition: Test separately before combining; shared catalog edits require a newly declared combined delta.
